text.en:
International Cargo & Parcel Delivery — UK to Turkey | Hanbros UK — Leader in UK–Turkey Logistics

Hanbros UK is the market leader in United Kingdom to Turkey cargo and parcel delivery. From a single carton to multi-pallet consignments, we move goods from every UK region to Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir and nationwide Turkish addresses with speed, transparency and full regulatory compliance.

Our groupage network runs scheduled departures each week, combining shipments from London, Birmingham, Manchester, Glasgow and beyond into efficient Turkey-bound loads. Post-Brexit export rules, Turkish import VAT and personal effects declarations are handled by our in-house customs team — so you never navigate complex paperwork alone.

Our Cargo & Parcel Services Include

  • Express parcels: 7–10 day door-to-door for urgent cartons and documents.
  • Standard groupage: Cost-effective shared loads for multiple boxes and suitcases.
  • Commercial cargo: Palletised freight with commercial invoices and HS codes.
  • Tracked delivery: Real-time status updates via WhatsApp and email.
  • Insurance: CMR standard cover plus optional All-Risk for valuable items.

Why choose Hanbros UK? We are not a generic freight forwarder — we are built exclusively for the United Kingdom to Turkey corridor, with bilingual staff, transparent pricing and thousands of satisfied customers.

Frequently Asked Questions

What can I send as cargo to Turkey?

Personal effects, clothing, electronics (where permitted), household items, business stock and general merchandise. Prohibited items include weapons, certain foodstuffs and undeclared commercial goods.

How is cargo priced?

By volume (cubic metres) or weight, whichever is greater. Use our Smart Calculator for an indicative quote, then confirm with our team for a fixed price.

Do you collect from my UK address?

Yes — door-to-door collection across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

Hanbros UK — England origin. Turkey delivered. Request your free quote today on hanbroscargo.co.uk.
